content: Prisma + pnpm workspaces: official pattern is a dedicated packages/database (or similar) package that owns schema.prisma and re-exports PrismaClient. Known pitfalls: pnpm symlink strategy can cause one generated client to overwrite another when multiple packages generate clients; custom generator output paths often break under pnpm's .pnpm store nesting causing 'cannot find module .prisma/client' errors.
